its branch; each run looks the branch up and builds its tip of the moment (pib package prints
the commit), and a moved tip is rebuilt. Users build their own kernel with --kernel-url and
--kernel-ref, or PIB_KERNEL_SRC (pib package --help). lttng-modules-modalix: v2.14.7, the
version of the release's lttng-modules-modalix 2.14-1. smifb-modalix is pinned in its config.
